case_title: RUSUL MCGILLAN ET AL VS. BENJAMIN NG

docket_entries.description: ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO OCTOBER 29, 2020 AT 1:30 P.M. D.506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-29-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF RUSUL MCGILLAN IS PRESENT. GLEN MCGILLAN TESTIFIES ON PLAINTIFF'S BEHALF. DEFENDANT BENJAMIN NG IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
